title: Thanksgiving Dinner for 10 Costs $58.63 #shorts
description:
The American Farm Bureau Federation's 41st annual survey: a classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 costs $58.63 in 2026, about $5.86 per person, up more than 6% from 2025. The 16-lb turkey is $23.68 (up 10.1%). Cranberries (+8.8%), whole milk (+8.6%) and dinner rolls (+7%) rose; the veggie tray, frozen pie crusts and frozen peas got cheaper. The meal is still $5.42 below the 2022 record of $64.05.

Source: American Farm Bureau Federation, "Cost of Thanksgiving Dinner Increases, Remains Below 2022 Record High" (fb.org, Nov 2026).
Why your whole grocery bill is up: https://youtu.be/T5cc_bivdow
Happy Thanksgiving from Coin Theory! Education only, not financial advice.
